title: MCP stdio command not available
explanation: Server "missing-cmd" cannot start: ./bin/nope.sh does not exist.
remediation: Install the command or fix the path.

title: MCP server URL looks malformed
explanation: URL "not-a-url" is not a valid http(s) URL.

title: MCP server references unset environment variables
explanation: Server "needs-env" references environment variable name(s) not present in this environment: DEVINSCOPE_FIXTURE_UNSET_VAR.
remediation: Set the variable(s) or adjust the server config.
